summary: 50-year-old Montrose man suffered a fatal medical emergency while mountain biking with his wife on the Prospect Trail loop in the Telluride ski area (just east of the bottom of Lift 11); bystanders and fellow riders started CPR; San Miguel County Sheriff's deputies/SAR and Telluride EMS attempted resuscitation but were unable to revive him
location: Prospect Trail loop, Telluride ski area
responding_agency: San Miguel County Sheriff's Office / SAR; Telluride EMS
notes: San Miguel County Sheriff’s Office news release dated July 2, 2017 (CivicAlert AID=193/ARC=522).
